transferFamilyInsecure.^description: {$COUNT} Transfer Family server(s) allow plaintext FTP or use an outdated security policy (TransferSecurityPolicy-2018-11, TransferSecurityPolicy-2020-06 or TransferSecurityPolicy-FIPS-2020-06). FTP sends user credentials and file contents unencrypted, and the older security policies still offer SHA-1 based and other legacy cryptographic algorithms. Use SFTP or FTPS and attach a current security policy such as TransferSecurityPolicy-2024-01 (or a FIPS equivalent).
transferFamilyInsecure.shortDesc: Disable FTP and use a current security policy
